## Data and software

<!-- This is a real strength of the record and is worth its own section: these
     are citable research outputs, not "other". Each entry: what it is, its
     scale, where it lives. Keep the figures identical to the ones the sites
     themselves publish. -->

- **FreeNIC** — an open Python and R package and server over 4,965,894,572 rows
  of US banking regulatory data, 1863–2026
  ([freenic.org](https://freenic.org)).
- **failing-banks** — an R package replicating Correia, Luck and Verner (2025),
  "Failing Banks" ([github.com/andenick/failing-banks](https://github.com/andenick/failing-banks)).
- **Heterodata** — the research-data platform gathering the interactive data
  sites and their downloads ([heterodata.org](https://heterodata.org)).
